correctness.rationale: Both covariance PGFs are reconstructed by conditioning one unordered reciprocal pair, deriving the changed Bernoulli marginal p’ of its two rows, evaluating endpoint and third-vertex indegree PGFs, and exact cancellation of constant and linear terms. Independent exact enumeration checks all 86 coefficients in 17 finite parameter configurations. Finite experiments are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Reciprocity measures mutual feedback, while the indegree histogram measures receipt and isolation. Their cross-statistic is important for understanding whether mutual arcs are associated with isolated input vertices. The complete all-k finite covariance transform yields every bin, exact conservation-law double zero, and a robust qualitative sign reversal solely from self-loop convention; this is a structural parameter-free mechanism, not a single arbitrary coefficient or routine marginal recomputation. A fixed-k Poisson second-difference profile explains the full asymptotic dependence pattern.
